method.index_tail_not_measured: index_tail_dn3_pct is NOT measured by this tool. It is certified on facts.LEVEL_PROTOCOL, where the roster varies with the seed, and this tool holds Universe.random(40, seed=111); the two protocols differ by 13.4 percent on pt-v16 (1.2749 varying against 1.124 held). A held-roster figure under this row's name would be compared with the certified one, so none is emitted. What would fill it: a level-protocol arm in this tool, which is a box job and a Phase 1 follow-on rather than part of the row's own branch.
method.reported_not_graded: vix_ar1_debiased is MEASURED AND REPORTED HERE, NOT GRADED. It is not in envelope.CERTIFIED, so it is not in PANEL, so it is in no in_band count, no misses list, no unreadable list, no mechanism block and no preset record. No band table this tool grades against carries the row -- facts.REAL_MARKETS, facts.REAL_MARKETS_UNIVERSAL and facts.REAL_MARKETS_RULED all lack it at both horizons -- and facts.RULED_UNREADABLE records why. That reason is READ FROM THE LIBRARY as this block is written, into band.reason beside the null, and is not restated here -- so it cannot go stale against facts.py the way a copied sentence would. THERE IS NO BAND FOR THIS ROW AND NONE IS INVENTED HERE. The block carries the real tape's windowed readings (facts.REAL_VIX_AR1_WINDOWS) so the model's reading can be compared by eye, and the row's edge liveness (facts.BAND_EDGE_LIVENESS), which records that the ceiling is dead by debias_ar1's own 1 + 4/n bound. Neither is a verdict.
method.absent_rows: A row in an absent_* list was MEASURED AND NOT READ: every seed of that cell refused it, with the reason facts recorded per seed. It is not a miss and not a pass. It is taken OUT of the in_band denominator, exactly as a row in an unreadable_* list is, and the two lists are kept apart because an unreadable row is a ruler with no band for it and an absent row is a run that could not read it. The rows that can be absent are preset_panel.ABSENT_OK, which is facts.DISPERSION: crisis_sector_dispersion needs facts.CRISIS_DISPERSION_MIN_SESSIONS sessions above facts.CRISIS_VIX_THRESHOLD inside its window, and a 252-day run of a calm preset holds fewer. The per-cell `dispersion` block carries how many of the cell's seeds read the row, the estimator the aggregate used over them, and the library's own sentences about the seeds that did not. A shape row is never absent: _job fetches it with p[k] and a run that dropped one fails there.
method.crisis_lever: annualised vol at held VIX 65 over held VIX 5, certified roster, 252 days, thirty seeds, after 252 discarded sessions at the pin. The burn is the eighth measurement defect of measurement-integrity.md repaired: without it each pin's window averages the factor variance's walk toward the pinned target, the two pins walk in opposite directions, and the ratio reads 4 to 8 per cent low by an amount that is a property of the preset
method.mechanism: facts.mechanism_verdict per row on the per-seed panels of the cell: an exact sign test against the row's mechanism-absent reading (facts.NULLS) at the cut the band's own false-alarm rate gives (facts.sign_cut). Three counts, never one: in band, mechanism shown, at real centre

maximum drawdown in the 2008 and 2020 replays within 30% of real
peak stock correlation in the 2008 and 2020 replays within 0.15 of real

mean length of a fear spell above VIX 30, sessions

sessions down more than 5% per decade

index annual volatility, %
long-run index return, % a year

crash rate in years 3-21 against years 1-2
histories touching the VIX ceiling, of 30
edge from reading a headline 5 ticks late, bp
65-minute lag-1 autocorrelation of print returns, median name; Roll spread over quoted
rows.rule: at or above -0.05, or Roll at most 2x quoted

rows.rule: every rule at most +5 points and 14 of 20
